IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCTPROD_OTH') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCTPROD_OTH;
END;

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)


SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM AccountProductSK) AS AccountProductSK,* 
INTO DW.ACCTPROD_OTH    
from(
   select distinct
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBCH.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm  
              
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND DDA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK  AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBCH ON BCA.BranchId = DDBCH.BranchID AND DDBCH.CurrentIndicator = 1
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','TRY','DEP')  
)a

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_OTH') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_OTH;
END;



WITH
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     convert(bigint,AccountSK)
    ,convert(varchar,AccountID)
    ,convert(bigint,ProductSK)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductID)
    ,convert(int,BankSK)
    ,convert(int,BranchSK)                
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.ACCTPROD_OTH
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    convert(bigint,AccountSK)
    ,convert(varchar,AccountID)
    ,convert(bigint,ProductSK)
    ,convert(varchar,ProductID)
    ,convert(int,BankSK)
    ,convert(int,BranchSK)                
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','TRY','DEP')  
)


    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
    ,ISNULL(SRC.ProductID,TGT.ProductID) AS ProductID
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL  THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'    
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
INTO DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_OTH	
FROM TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.AccountID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL)

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimAccountProduct TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_OTH DELTA ON DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.ACCTPROD_OTH SRC ON SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK  AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID  AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND TGT.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','TRY','DEP') ;

INSERT INTO DW.DimAccountProduct (
AccountProductSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,ProductSK
,ProductID
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm      )              
SELECT
AccountProductSK
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,ProductSK
,SRC.ProductID
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm  
FROM DW.ACCTPROD_OTH SRC
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_OTH DELTA ON DELTA.ProductID = SRC.ProductID AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')

,-1 AS BranchSK

where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'  
GROUP BY
DDA.AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId
,DDP.ProductSK
,BCAFP.ProductID
,DDB.BankSK
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode 
) a

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCTPROD_TRY') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCTPROD_TRY;
END;

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)

SELECT  
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM AccountProductSK) AS AccountProductSK,* 
INTO DW.ACCTPROD_TRY     
from(
   select distinct
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,convert(varchar,BTT.CounterPartyId) AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BTTFP.FinancialProductId) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,NULL AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BTTFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode  --change from dimaccount
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm      
FROM BNKM.TreasuryTrade BTT
LEFT JOIN BNKM.TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct BTTFP ON BTTFP.TradeId = BTT.TradeId AND BTTFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BTT.FinancialInstitutionId AND BTT.SourceSystemCode = BTTFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON convert(varchar,BTT.CounterPartyId) = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BTT.SourceSystemCode AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BTT.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BTTFP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = BTTFP.SOURCESYSTEMCODE AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BTTFP.FinancialProductId = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BankSK = DDB.BankSK  AND BTT.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode AND DDB.BankSK = DDP.BankSK AND DDP.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE BTTFP.SourceSystemCode <> 'DEP' --FOR SEPARATE DEP FILTER
)a

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCTPROD_DEP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCTPROD_DEP;
END;

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)


SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM AccountProductSK) AS AccountProductSK,* 
INTO DW.ACCTPROD_DEP   
from(
   select distinct
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBCH.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm    
          
FROM (SELECT CustomerAccountId,ProductID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND (PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR  PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01') AND ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%') GROUP BY CustomerAccountId,ProductID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId ) BCAFP
JOIN DW.FINLPRODUCTAPP FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionID = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN (SELECT BranchId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' GROUP BY BranchId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode) BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK,AccountID,BankSK,SourceSystemCode FROM DW.DimAccount WHERE CURRENTINDICATOR = 1) DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDA.SourceSystemCode 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ProductSK,ProductID,BANKSK,SourceSystemCode FROM DW.DimProduct WHERE CURRENTINDICATOR = 1) DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode  
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBCH ON BCA.BranchId = DDBCH.BranchID AND DDBCH.CURRENTINDICATOR = 1
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
)a

    SELECT distinct A.* INTO DW.FINLPRODUCTAPP
